_comment: USD per 1M tokens. The single source of truth for every rate in this repo: work/ocr/scripts/pricing.py reads it for the Python pipeline, scripts/enqueue_ocr_all.mjs for the dry-run estimate. Two languages needed the same three numbers, and a copy in each would be a duplicated signal needing a parity test to stay honest. A model absent here costs null rather than a plausible wrong number - gemini-3-flash-preview is deliberately absent because Google publishes no rate for it.
